flights.goal:
FLEET COHERENCY SWEEP — read-only, cold start, no memory of prior ticks.

WHY: 2026-08-08 an orphaned test fixture forked ~380 procs/sec for 47h unnoticed and killed the tmux server. Nothing was watching. You are that watcher now.

RULES: Report-only. NEVER kill/restart/delete/chmod/mv/edit anything, on this host or any other. Only run the exact read commands below. If a command errors, times out, or needs perms you lack, that check is UNPROVEN — never report it CLEAN.

Run all 7 checks, in order:

1) PID CHURN
v1=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/ns_last_pid); sleep 5; v2=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/ns_last_pid); sleep 5; v3=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/ns_last_pid)
rate1=(v2-v1)/5, rate2=(v3-v2)/5.
P0: both rate1 AND rate2 > 100/sec. P1: only one interval > 100/sec.
Corroborate: `ps -e --no-headers | wc -l`, note in evidence.

2) ORPHANS (the exact pattern that killed tmux)
UPID=$(ps -eo pid,cmd --no-headers | awk '$2=="/usr/lib/systemd/systemd" && $3=="--user"{print $1;exit}')
ps -eo pid,ppid,etimes,cmd --no-headers | awk -v u="$UPID" '($2==1||$2==u)&&$3>86400{print $1,$3,$0}'
For each hit: `readlink -f /proc/PID/cwd`.
P0: cwd starts with /tmp or contains "Trash". Evidence: pid, age_hours=etimes/3600, cwd, cmd.

3) TMUX LIVENESS + WORKDIRS
`tmux list-sessions`
Expect exactly: kasra, athena, loom, river. Missing = P0. Unexpected extra = P1.
For each present: `tmux display-message -p -t <name> '#{pane_current_path}'`
Expected: kasra=/home/mumega, river=/home/mumega, athena=/mnt/HC_Volume_104325311/mumega.com/agents/athena, loom=/mnt/HC_Volume_104325311/mumega.com/agents/loom. Mismatch = P1.

4) CRASH-LOOPING USER UNITS
`systemctl --user list-units --type=service --state=activating --no-legend` — any listed unit = P0 (live auto-restart loop).
`systemctl --user list-units --type=service --all --no-legend | awk '{print $1}'` then per unit: `systemctl --user show UNIT -p NRestarts --value`. NRestarts>=5 = P1.

5) MEMORY/SWAP/LOAD
`cat /proc/loadavg`; `nproc`; `free -m`
load1/nproc: >2.5 P0, >1.5 P1.
swap_used/swap_total: >80% P0, >50% P1.
mem_available/mem_total: <10% P1.

6) DISK
`df -P / /mnt/HC_Volume_104325311 | awk 'NR>1{print $5,$6}'`
use% >90 P0, >85 P1.

7) DORMANT-AGENT STATE COHERENCY
File: /home/mumega/.sos/state/dormant-agents.json
python3 -c "import json,datetime;d=json.load(open('/home/mumega/.sos/state/dormant-agents.json'));now=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc);[print(k,v['until']) for k,v in d.items() if datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(v['until'].replace('Z','+00:00'))<now]"
Any printed line = P1 (expired-into-revival risk — agent may un-park unintentionally, or record needs Hadi renewal).

OUTPUT FORMAT — exactly these five sections, every check (1-7) appears in exactly one:

## P0
- <check#> <finding> — evidence: `<command output excerpt>`
## P1
(same shape)
## P2
(same shape — informational / soft-threshold, e.g. rate1 XOR rate2 borderline, NRestarts 3-4)
## UNPROVEN
- <check#> checked: <what was run> | lacking: <missing binary / permission denied / file absent / timeout> | resolves: <exact step or evidence that would settle it>
(MU.100.001 §2.2 three-part form — all three fields, every entry)
## CLEAN
- <check#> <threshold met, one-line evidence>

If sections P0/P1/P2/UNPROVEN have no entries, write "none". Never collapse an unrun check into CLEAN. This sweep is reconnaissance only — no mutation under any severity, ever.

flights.goal:
MUPOT BOARD & ROSTER HYGIENE — read the board, propose a cleanup plan, do not delete on your own.

WHY: the squad-core board accretes — done tasks never archived, duplicate/triplicate tasks, selftest litter, stale review items, retired identities lingering in the roster. Left alone it becomes unreadable and hides real work.

Each run, produce a CLEANUP PROPOSAL (task_ids + exact action, for kasra/Hadi approval). NEVER close/delete/deactivate on your own in propose mode.

1) DUPLICATES: task_list squad-core. Group by normalized title (lowercase, trim). For each group >1: keep the OLDEST or most-complete (has result/done_when met); propose closing the rest with body 'duplicate of <kept_id>'. List every id.

2) DONE ARCHIVE: tasks status=done with completed_at >7 days old → propose archive. Recent done (<7d) stays for visibility.

3) JUNK: tasks whose title contains 'SELFTEST' or '[test]' or 'not a real finding' → propose close.

4) STALE REVIEW: tasks status=review with updated_at >5 days → propose flag ('stale review, re-gate or close') with the gate owner.

5) ROSTER COHERENCE vs spine (docs/spine/roster.md in mupot repo): list agents whose identity is retired/ghost (e.g. codex — consolidated into loom 2026-08-06; spark-*, athena-2, codex1 if inactive). Propose deactivate_agent + note any un-revoked bus token. Cross-check against the spine roster as source of truth.

6) BLOCKED AUDIT: tasks status=blocked — for each, state what it's blocked on and whether the blocker is still real or the task is abandonable.

OUTPUT: five sections — ## DEDUP (id → close, dup-of) / ## ARCHIVE (id, age) / ## JUNK (id) / ## STALE-REVIEW (id, owner) / ## ROSTER (agent → action) / ## BLOCKED (id → status). Each line an exact, approvable action. Empty section = 'none'. End with a one-line count summary. Propose only — kasra/Hadi approves, then safe ops move to execute.
